image_slots.scene_description: কাক — কয়েকটি কাক (কাক শব্দের ছবি); single-species animal spotlight (NCTB p30 এর মতো কাক), কোনো মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: crows (কাক) — one or two, matching NCTB p30; birds kept in upper two-thirds so stripe lands on plain ground clear of them; no people; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A clean children's-textbook illustration of one or two crows standing on the ground, side profile, on a plain white background. Simple bold outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: কাগজ — NCTB p30 তে দুই শিশু একসাথে বই/কাগজ পড়ছে (C-01 pair + C-02 dress)। object-first: একগুচ্ছ কাগজ ও একটি খোলা বই, মানুষ ছাড়া। (বিকল্প: same-gender cast pair — নিচে refs দেওয়া হলো, রিভিউয়ার বাছবেন।)
image_slots.compliance_note: NCTB p30 shows two children reading together (C-01 pairing + C-02 dress + AI-baked text on the page). OBJECT-FIRST replacement: a stack of paper (কাগজ) and one open blank book, no figures, no in-image text (script guard). No living being, no stripe. If reviewer prefers figures, downgrade to same-gender cast pair (উমর+আনাস) modest dress, blank book.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a neat stack of paper sheets beside one open book with blank pages, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no text or letters anywhere on the pages, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.compliance_note: object-only tree; no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a single leafy tree, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects, no people. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.compliance_note: object-only wheel; no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a single cart wheel, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects, no people. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: কাকা — 'কাকা' (uncle) শব্দের ছবি: এক প্রাপ্তবয়স্ক পুরুষ (কাকা) মৃদু হেসে দাঁড়িয়ে; পূর্ণ দাড়ি ও শালীন পূর্ণ পোশাক। একক পুরুষ।
image_slots.compliance_note: কাকা = uncle, an adult male figure (C-05 + C-02). Single adult male with FULL BEARD, modest full-length clothing (full-sleeve, hem below ankle) + cap, standing/smiling gently; incidental adult (not cast child); no other people. Stripe lands on plain area clear of face/hands; high-contrast line-art for B/W. (If reviewer prefers object-only, this word alone can be dropped to word-only — but কাকা is a person by meaning.)
image_slots.prompt: A gentle children's-textbook illustration of a single adult man with a full beard, wearing modest full-length clothing and a cap, standing and smiling kindly. Plain white background, soft watercolour style, clean bold outlines. No bare skin beyond face and hands, no other people. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

lessons.notes: পাঠ ২১ আ-কার শিখি (🔒 স্থির; FIRST কারচিহ্ন lesson — আ-কার া introduced here; যোগ্যতা ১৩.২ বর্ণ-যোজনা). User: keep কাক+কাগজ, add more আ-কার words, replace images. LETTER AUDIT NOW LIVE (first decodable school-written content). পাঠ ২১ decodable inventory = vowels অ–ঔ + consonants ক খ গ ঘ ঙ চ ছ জ ঝ ঞ ONLY + া; conjunct_whitelist=null → B-1 default NONE (no যুক্তবর্ণ). Added words chosen decodable-safe (user chose decodable, not oral): গাছ, চাকা, কাকা — ALL audit-pass (only ক-ঞ consonants + া, no conjuncts). Rejected common আ-কার words that FAIL audit at পাঠ ২১ (untaught consonants): কলা/জাল/ঝাল/খাল(ল), ছাতা(ত), জামা/কামান(ম), চাঁদ(দ), খাবার(ব,র), আকাশ(শ), ছানা/কাঁকন(ন) — proves the audit is doing real work. b08 = decodable_text source=school edited=true oral=FALSE → AUDITED (passes). কাক/কাগজ kept (NCTB-original). IMAGES (replace): কাক = crows single-species stripe; কাগজ — NCTB two-children-reading (C-01 pair + C-02 dress + AI-baked page text) → OBJECT-FIRST stack-of-paper+blank-book (no figures, no in-image text/script-guard); reviewer may swap to same-gender cast pair. New-word images: গাছ/চাকা object-only; কাকা(uncle)=adult male, reframed FULL BEARD + modest full dress + cap (C-02/C-05), stripe. আ-কার tracing = vector_asset, prompt='' permanently. c_codes C-05/C-02/C-06/C-01/C-08. Ready to merge after পাঠ ২০. NOTE: conjunct_whitelist for পাঠ ২১ REMAINS null/needs_review in inventory (D-009) — not resolved here because no replacement text needed a conjunct; flagged as still-open for any future পাঠ-২১ conjunct use.
